## Change

- `packages/journeys/src/session.ts` — the 275_R6WEB.1 confirm-click arm extracted to exported
  `confirmMagicLinkInterstitial(page)`; the mint path calls it (behavior identical).
- `packages/journeys/src/steps.ts` — the inline N1 (held-draft) and N3 arms call the helper
  immediately after `gotoOk(page, link, ctx)`. No-op when the link lands on the verify GET
  directly (old-format links).

## Why the inline arms differ from the mint path

N1/N3 must sign in **inside the anonymous context that already holds the IndexedDB draft** —
`sessions.signIn` mints a fresh context whose storage partition has no hold. The legs therefore
navigate the emailed link themselves; the interstitial arm had to exist there too.
